content: For the first round, we used a BERT-Large model BIBREF10 trained on a concatenation of SNLI BIBREF1 and MNLI BIBREF22, and selected the best-performing model we could train as the starting point for our dataset collection procedure. For Round 1 contexts, we randomly sampled short multi-sentence passages from Wikipedia (of 250-600 characters) from the manually curated HotpotQA training set BIBREF23. Contexts are either ground-truth contexts from that dataset, or they are Wikipedia passages retrieved using TF-IDF BIBREF24 based on a HotpotQA question.
